projects.name: matchai
projects.description: Matchai is a modern life dashboard in development that aims to simplify complex page setups by providing a single view of all your routines and to-do’s at a glance. It eliminates the need for hours of setup by offering customizable pre-functioning “widgets” that cover everything from daily tasks, workouts, calendar events, mood logs, and more.

projects.name: wayvilo
projects.description: Wayvilo was a Washington Metro PWA that provided users a simple platform to plan their trip on DC transit. It functioned similarly to the app, “Transit,” using a Node.js framework, alongside a combination of DMV transit API's and public GTFS feeds to predict trip headways and fare costs.

projects.name: pask
projects.description: Pask was my submission for the 2025 WWDC Student Swift Challenge, which aimed to teach the fundamentals of online security in an fun and engaging way. Inspired off of Duolingo's gamified design, users were challenged to secure a vault by completing quests. Users redeem “key fragments” by completing security questions and gaining knowledge.
